How comfortable the app thinks you are with each Spanish grammar drill. As your comfort rises, it makes that drill a little harder and shows it less often, to keep you challenged.

Train yourself to catch spoken numbers and times instantly. Set up a practice pool of audio clips first — they generate once and are reused across sessions.

No comfort score — its difficulty just follows your chosen level (%1$s).
Everything — vocabulary, chats, texts, audio, settings — in one zip. API keys and downloadable packs are not included.

Suggest new topics and retry failed chats while the app is closed. Uses your API key.

The share of reviews you aim to get right. Higher means cards come back sooner and you review more often; lower means longer gaps and more forgetting. This applies to this language only.
Sets target recall to %1$d%% for %2$s. Cards move onto the new schedule as you grade them — due dates already set won\'t change until then.
Shown as a target line on the home tracker; days that reach it are highlighted.
